title: Palindrome Name
statement: Given a string, return true if it reads the same forwards and backwards after ignoring every character that is not a letter or digit and ignoring upper and lower case.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers moving inward from both ends
keyPoints: Skip characters that are not letters or digits on each side
Compare characters case-insensitively; if different return false
Move both pointers inward until they meet, then return true
edgeCases: String with only symbols returns true
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Build a cleaned lowercase copy and compare it with its reverse: O(n) time but O(n) extra space

hints: Do you need a cleaned copy of the string, or can you skip characters as you go?
Put one pointer at each end and move them toward each other.
Skip non-letters on each side before comparing, and compare in lowercase.
